mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 2%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in CPIAUCSL above 3.0% annualized rate signals an inflationary environment that triggers Fed tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market, which typically leads to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of UNRATE falling and PAYEMS rising occurs in more than 50% of cases where 60-day SPX returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by housing starts above 1400 thousand units and retail sales above $500 billion), the S&P 500 typically experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to overvaluation and impending economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1400 and RSAFS exceeds 500000.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with declining corporate hiring and weaker consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between UNRATE and 20-day SPX returns is not negative (i.e., correlation > 0) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1300 thousand units indicates a deteriorating housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST falls below 1300.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a slowdown in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of INDPRO falling and GDPC1 growth slowing occurs in more than 50% of cases where 60-day SPX returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS above 2.5% and CPIAUCSL above 3.0%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as higher interest rates and inflationary pressures reduce equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.
